items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: like K.D. or even early Miles or Dizzy or Fats

ctx.x: Oh man yeah. What a gentleman he was. And in studying him I think we realized he wasn’t as steeped in some of the bop traditions as some of the other guys like Kenny Dorham or something like that, in terms of harmony. But he was just such a beautiful player. He’s what I think of as being more of a diatonic player. And some guys would disagree with me on that. But he didn’t get in the cracks as much as like K.D. or even early Miles or Dizzy or Fats, even though Fats was a huge influence to Clifford. Huge. If you…
